# `scikitplot.cython`

<!-- Generated by `python tools/maint_tools/generate_usage_skills.py sync` from the installed package; edit the module's docstrings or `__all__`, not this file. -->

A lightweight runtime Cython development kit with caching, pinning, garbage collection, and templating support.

## Install

```sh
pip install scikit-plots
pip install scikit-plots-cython  # this part only
```

## Before writing code

The API below was read from one version of the package. Check the version the
project has, and read a name's docstring and signature before calling it:

```sh
python -c "import scikitplot; print(scikitplot.__version__)"
python -c "import scikitplot.cython as m, inspect; print(inspect.signature(m.<name>)); help(m.<name>)"
```

## Example (from the docstring of `scikitplot.cython.register_compiler`)

```pycon
>>> class custom_fast:
...     name = "custom_fast"
...
...     def __call__(self, source, *, build_dir, module_name, **kw):
...         raise NotImplementedError
>>> register_compiler(custom_fast())
>>> "custom_fast" in list_compilers()
True
```
